subject: Post-call qualification: metrics pack, model recommendations, and hotfix path
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ariel Watkins <ariel@clearledger.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-call: recommended models, metrics pack, and next steps

Hi Ariel — great to chat this morning. Thanks for the context on the two core flows: invoice-categorization (high recall, low hallucination tolerance) and customer Q&A (latency-sensitive). Recap + what we attached: 

What we sent (attachments & links)
- eval-pack-v1.zip (contains: sample prompts, labeled reference set, evaluation scripts)
- prompt-sets-clearledger.csv (recommended prompt families and temperature/net settings)
- benchmark-summary-20270831.pdf (multi-variant token cost and latency table)
- Drive link with raw outputs: https://drive.redwood.ai/open?id=drive-eval-pack-CL-2027-019

Model recommendations (initial)
- redwood-14b-v2 (default candidate): best accuracy on labeled set; higher token cost but stronger compositional reasoning for categorization rules.
- redwood-7b-q4f (fallback): similar latency and lower cost; acceptable for low-complexity Q&A.

Key fit concerns you raised
- Recent production update at ClearLedger caused a bump in hallucination cases on invoice examples (examples attached in eval-pack).
- You want a mechanism to lock evaluation traffic to a stable model variant during the trial and a clear rollback path in case of quality regression.

Proposed immediate steps
1) We will snapshot/publish a model artifact: redwood-14b-v2@20270830 (this is a frozen inference artifact that you can run against the eval pack).
2) Run a quick smoke eval (we can run it from our side within 48 hours) and share a short report.
3) Agree on simple rollback triggers (precision drop > 6% on invoice-classification or hallucination rate > 1.5% on critical prompts).
4) Schedule a 30-minute check-in next Thursday to review smoke results and decide pin/freeze.

Can you confirm the week/time that works for your team and whether procurement needs any paperwork to enable the trial?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
(attachment: eval-pack-v1.zip)
From: Ariel Watkins <ariel@clearledger.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Data Science <datasci@clearledger.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: recommended models, metrics pack, and next steps

Thanks Naomi — very helpful summary. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- We can host a short trial but we need a way to ensure the model version doesn’t drift during our evaluation. Can you confirm what "snapshot/publish" means operationally? Will inference traffic be pinned to an immutable artifact?
- We have some compliance folks asking for a rollback playbook in the event we see increased hallucinations; can you sketch what that would look like?
- Procurement will likely ask for a short SOW for the trial. I can get a template over — does Redwood accept a 30-day trial SOW with a capped usage estimate?

We attached two flagged examples from our side (invoice-189.pdf outputs.txt). Short answer: we want to be able to test without surprises and a clear hotfix path if we see regressions.

Ariel
Ariel Watkins | Head of Product, ClearLedger
ariel@clearledger.ai
(attachment: invoice-189.pdf; invoice-189-outputs.txt)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: recommended models, metrics pack, and next steps

Looping in technical ops and a quick internal recommendation after reviewing the flagged outputs: 

Technical notes (internal) - The examples show an edge-case where the newer tokenization path for dates produced inconsistent entity spans; that aligns with a small delta we previously observed between 14b-v1 -> 14b-v2.
- We can create an immutable model snapshot (artifact) tied to a build hash: redwood-14b-v2@20270830-hash-e74f. Once deployed to the trial namespace we can configure routing to point only at that artifact (no auto-updates).

Recommended approach to minimize customer churn risk
1) Create the snapshot and deploy to a dedicated trial cluster for ClearLedger.
2) Configure routing: 100% traffic -> redwood-14b-v2@20270830-hash-e74f. No auto-roll for 14 days.
3) Add a cheap fallback: redwood-7b-q4f@20270825 (used only if the primary fails health checks). Fallback as a safety, not for normal queries.
4) Define measurable rollback triggers (precision drop > 6% or hallucination increase > 1.5% on agreed prompt set).

Rollback / hotfix playbook (sketch)
- Detection: daily smoke run against eval-pack (run at 03:00 UTC) and immediate alert on trigger breach.
- Action 0: If degradation is minor (within tolerance) open a low-priority ticket and increase monitoring.
- Action 1: If breach persists >1 hour, shift routing to fallback (7b) and notify customer + AE.
- Action 2: If major regression or safety issue, immediate rollback to previous stable artifact (14b-v1@20270720) and schedule a postmortem.

I'll prepare the snapshot and a short ops runbook. Naomi — if procurement needs a trial SOW, we can attach a boilerplate SOW with capped usage.

Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ariel Watkins <ariel@clearledger.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: recommended models, metrics pack, and next steps

Ariel — thanks for the examples, that makes the ask concrete and helpful. Quick confirmation of the plan (agreeing to Karthik’s sketch):

Finalized prep steps (we will do these within 48 hours)
- Snapshot and publish artifact: redwood-14b-v2@20270830-hash-e74f (immutable; no auto-updates in trial namespace).
- Deploy snapshot to a dedicated trial cluster for ClearLedger; configure routing to the snapshot (100% routing).
- Set up daily smoke runs against the attached eval-pack; results will land in the Drive link and we will share a short report.
- Implement the rollback/hotfix playbook Karthik outlined (detection -> fallback -> rollback ladder).

Procurement / SOW - We accept a 30-day trial SOW with capped usage; I’ll attach our trial SOW template to HubSpot and copy your procurement contact.

Next steps / asks for you
1) Can you confirm who from ClearLedger will own the trial approval (procurement or security)?
2) Can you confirm availability for a 30-minute checkpoint next Thursday 10:00 AM PT (I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm)?

If that sounds good I’ll attach the trial SOW and the ops runbook to HubSpot and kick off snapshot deployment.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
(attachments: trial-sow-template.pdf; ops-runbook-sketch.txt)
